case_name: KIWI-007 Testimony Quantity Concealment + Panic Button
executive_summary: The active witness (brother) claims real-time notification of defendant's conduct via screenshots but cannot produce the device, does not know his own brother's phone number, and the defendant has had him actively blocked for years — making real-time access to defendant's content physically impossible. A peripheral witness knows the exact download quantity (10GB) while the primary downloader (the brother) does not declare any quantity — an inverse precision pattern that is a Grice Quantity violation indicating active concealment. The panic button claim is verifiable via police records and constitutes the only potentially confirmable artifact. CAIE composite=0.0104 (NOISE for accusations against defendant). Structural analysis elevates to SUSPICION for the testimony's internal inconsistencies.

peircean_analysis.firstness: KIWI-007-A01 (brother): claims real-time notification via screenshots, cannot produce phone, does not know his brother's phone number, defendant has had him blocked for years. Download quantity declared by brother: null. KIWI-007-A02 (panic button): activated claiming defendant's physical presence. Police record with timestamp, GPS, dispatched unit — independently verifiable via police records. Claimed outcome: defendant fled. KIWI-007-A03 (precision asymmetry): peripheral Testigo-A from KIWI-006 declares brother downloaded exactly 10GB. Brother himself declares no quantity.
peircean_analysis.secondness: Three structural anomalies: (A) Technical impossibility — the defendant has had the brother blocked for years. A blocked contact cannot view the blocking party's content in real time or receive their communications. The claimed surveillance mechanism is technically impossible given the block status. (B) Inverse precision pattern — Grice's Quantity maxim requires speakers to provide the information they have. The brother, who conducted the download, should know the quantity better than a peripheral associate. The reversal (peripheral knows exact figure; primary actor knows nothing) is structurally anomalous: it indicates the primary actor is actively concealing the quantity. (C) Evidence production failure — real-time notification claims require preserved screenshots. Inability to produce the device is inconsistent with a genuine real-time monitoring claim.
peircean_analysis.thirdness: The testimony pattern indicates strategic information management rather than honest recall. The brother conceals his download quantity (Grice Quantity violation), claims a surveillance method that is technically impossible (Grice Quality violation), and cannot produce the evidence he claims to have generated (evidence withholding). The peripheral witness's knowledge of the exact quantity (10GB) reveals the figure is known to the network but is being deliberately suppressed by the primary actor. This is deceptive testimony management, not honest witness limitation. The panic button claim, if police records confirm the dispatch, provides the only potentially truthful element — but even this requires verification of whether defendant was actually present.

maxim_quantity_brother.description: Primary actor (most active downloader) provides zero quantity information. Peripheral witness provides exact quantity. Whoever has the most information provides the least — active concealment, not ignorance.

maxim_quality_brother.description: Claims real-time notification via a technically impossible channel (blocked contact). The stated surveillance method cannot have functioned as described.

maxim_quantity_panic.description: Panic button claim is specific (timestamp, GPS, dispatched unit, verifiable via police records). This is Grice-compliant testimony — verifiable, specific, independently confirmable.

hypotheses.H1_honest_recall: Brother genuinely monitored defendant's content via some other channel, panicked when confronted with a blocked status, and forgot the download amount under stress.
hypotheses.H2_testimony_management: Brother deliberately conceals download quantity and frames a technically impossible surveillance claim to avoid disclosing his own monitoring behavior while attributing harmful conduct to defendant.

refutation_protocol.benign_hypothesis: H1: Stress and poor memory could explain the phone production failure and number ignorance. The block could have been lifted and re-applied, creating a window of access.
refutation_protocol.test_result: H1 PARTIALLY REFUTED: (A) Not knowing one's own phone number is an unusual memory failure inconsistent with routine device ownership — not explained by stress. (B) The inverse precision pattern requires that the peripheral witness independently knows the brother's download quantity — this is only possible if the quantity was discussed within the network, which means the brother knows it and is concealing it, not forgetting it. (C) The block status is documented as current and of long standing ('for years') — an occasional lift-and-reapply would require evidence the block was ever removed.
refutation_protocol.refutation_outcome: H1 partially refuted. H2 consistent with all observed anomalies. Verdict: SUSPICION for testimony integrity.

devil_advocate: The brother's failure to know his own number could indicate he primarily uses the device for data (messaging apps) rather than voice, where the number is irrelevant. The quantity concealment could be embarrassment rather than strategic deception. The panic button activation is a verifiable act — activation itself is not fabricated even if the claimed reason could be disputed. Counter: the convergence of all three anomalies (technical impossibility, quantity concealment, evidence withholding) in a single witness strains the incompetence explanation.

findings.title: Brother's Testimony — Technical Impossibility and Quantity Concealment
findings.firstness: Claims real-time surveillance via blocked contact; declares no download quantity while peripheral witness knows 10GB
findings.secondness: Block status renders claimed channel impossible; inverse precision pattern violates Grice Quantity
findings.thirdness: Active concealment of download activity and quantity while constructing false surveillance narrative
findings.carnegie: Carnegie Scarcity — creates urgency and danger claims without verifiable supporting evidence
findings.devil_advocate: Could be honest confusion and embarrassment
findings.corroboration: Peripheral witness's exact knowledge of the quantity independently confirms the figure is known to the network (two-source confirmation of the concealment)
